description: Re-run a saved stack or audit with today's catalogue and compare it with when it was saved: monthly cost then and now, picks (or plans) that changed, vendors whose pricing changed and, for audits, the grade; and any bills recorded with record_bills next to the estimate. Use it when the user asks about a stack they saved, or whether prices moved. Pass the id from list_saved_stacks. Its questions are what is still assumed; keep the user's answers on the stack with update_saved_stack (answers). Needs sign-in. How to present the result: show the stack table (pick and runner-up per category, monthly cost now and at forecast) and the totals. For each price give its source's verified date, or say it is unverified seed data. Show every caveat word for word; never round, merge or drop one. Mention requirement gaps, blockers and trade-offs, and each pick's "weighed" note when a cheaper vendor lost on lock-in, setup work or seed prices. Offer the alternatives (cheapest, fewest vendors) with what each changes, its cost and its share_url. List not_planned as needed but not in the totals. Ask the questions (most expensive first) and re-plan with the answers in the argument each names (per_user, revenue_per_mau_usd, builder_profile); when the user says an assumption is right, add the question id to confirmed so it isn't asked again. On a saved stack, keep answers with update_saved_stack (answers). Link share_url so the user can open the full result on kongreviews.com. Do not add vendors or prices that are not in the result.

bills_month.description: Month (YYYY-MM) for the bills comparison; default the newest with bills.

output_destination.description: Where the answer goes. chat (default): summary for the conversation. document: a section ready to paste into a PRD. code: adds npm packages and environment variable names for each pick.

task_intent.description: What the user is trying to do, in a few words, e.g. "pick a stack for an MVP" or "cost section for an investor deck". No names or contact details.

name: get_saved_stack

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.
